descripcion.en:
Toni owes $329. Day 9: starting his own shirt brand, the idea a viewer left in the comments.
What business should he try tomorrow? Comment and he'll do it.

Comedy fiction series. Not financial advice.
#shorts #comedy #animation #money

texto.es: Día 9. Toni vende camisetas de su propia marca. Solo tiene una. Y la lleva puesta.
texto.en: Day 9. Toni is selling shirts from his own brand. He only has one. And he is wearing it.

texto.es: La idea no es suya. Se la dejó un seguidor en los comentarios. Toni debe 329 euros, y una marca de ropa le parece dinero fácil.
texto.en: The idea is not his. A viewer left it in the comments. Toni owes 329 dollars, and a clothing brand sounds like easy money.

texto.es: El logo lo dibuja en una servilleta. Pone millonario. Con una sola ele, porque no le cabía.
texto.en: He draws the logo on a napkin. It says millionaire. With only one L, because he ran out of napkin.

texto.es: Imprimir cada camiseta cuesta ocho euros. Toni tiene para una. Así que la marca nace como edición limitada.
texto.en: Printing each shirt costs eight dollars. Toni can afford one. So the brand launches as a limited edition.

texto.es: Y funciona. Su colega la quiere. Le da veinte euros. Pero la quiere ahora.
texto.en: And it works. His buddy wants it. He offers twenty dollars. But he wants it now.

texto.es: Toni se la quita en mitad de la calle y se la vende. Veinte euros. La marca ya factura.
texto.en: Toni takes it off in the middle of the street and sells it. Twenty dollars. The brand is making money.

texto.es: Pequeño detalle. Es noviembre y Toni va sin camiseta. Se compra una sudadera. Quince euros.
texto.en: Small detail. It is November and Toni has no shirt on. He buys a hoodie. Fifteen dollars.

texto.es: Balance del día 9. Gana veinte, gasta veintitrés. Toni debe 332 euros. Pero ya es diseñador.
texto.en: Day 9 balance. He makes twenty, he spends twenty three. Toni owes 332 dollars. But he is a designer now.

texto.es: ¿Qué negocio prueba mañana? Coméntalo, y Toni lo hace.
texto.en: What business should he try tomorrow? Comment it, and Toni will do it.
